optionRationales.reason: an invitation to the Friday school show at the music room：完整逐字稿明確支持此項。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Friday school show at the music room」。

an invitation to a show at the music room on Sunday：此項把「the Friday school show at the music room」改成「a show at the music room on Sunday」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Friday school show at the music room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Friday school show at the music room」。

a request to move the show from the music room：此項把「an invitation to the Friday school show at」改成「a request to move the show from」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Friday school show at the music room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Friday school show at the music room」。

a question about tickets for the music room：此項把「an invitation to the Friday school show at」改成「a question about tickets for」。整段對話的主要功能為「an invitation to the Friday school show at the music room」。因此，鎖定證據支持「an invitation to the Friday school show at the music room」。
